subject: Get count info from ggvis histogram tooltip?

messages.author: 2996ea0716ec347a
messages.subject: Get count info from ggvis histogram tooltip?
parts:
Does anyone know if there is a way to get count info from a ggvis histogram tooltip? It would be great to roll over the bars and see the exact y count data.

Thanks,

Sharon

messages.author: 912329a6ad1a6995
messages.subject: Re: Get count info from ggvis histogram tooltip?
parts:
Hi Sharon,

In the absence of an official way, this might be a workaround:

library("ggvis")

cocaine %>%
  ggvis(x = ~weight) %>%
  layer_histograms() %>%
  add_tooltip(function(df) (df$stack_upr_ - df$stack_lwr_))

This should work if your call to layer_histograms() uses the default stack = TRUE.

If you set stack = FALSE, this could be a way to do it:

cocaine %>%
  ggvis(x = ~weight) %>%
  layer_histograms(stack = FALSE) %>%
  add_tooltip(function(df) df$count_)

This takes advantage of the internals of the layer_histogram() code (https://github.com/rstudio/ggvis/blob/master/R/layer_bins.R), so there's no guarantee that this is a stable workaround.

Hope this helps.

BTW, I really dig your Computerworld work.

Ian
